question: Should `openclaw.ai` consume the design system from a public/package-registry or HTTPS source, or should maintainers grant CI/Vercel a cross-repository SSH credential for this private dependency?
rationale: The patch is mechanically small, but the unresolved choice changes the repository's build access and deployment credential boundary; automation cannot safely choose that policy.

options.title: Use a deployable public source
options.body: Publish or expose the design-system release through a source that clean clones, GitHub Actions, and Vercel can fetch without private SSH credentials, then update the dependency and skills lock accordingly.

options.title: Approve private build credentials
options.body: Grant a least-privilege deploy key or secret to the required hosted builders and document the credential scope, rotation, and failure mode before merge.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Keep the draft blocked or close it until design-system distribution policy is settled outside this consumer repository.

recommendation.title: Use a deployable public source
recommendation.body: Publish or expose the design-system release through a source that clean clones, GitHub Actions, and Vercel can fetch without private SSH credentials, then update the dependency and skills lock accordingly.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the site product-boundary document and recent dependency changes, so they are the best available owner for the deploy credential versus public distribution decision.
